translation.name: Kitapm kɛn Raa dɔɔko kiji ute jeege

content: *Ko Taar kɛn Raa ɛɗo Musa ki se taaɗjeki ɓo kaam nirl nakgen bɛɛ utu aɗe ɓaa naan ki sum; kɛse taaɗ te nakgen mala mala eyo. Anum ute Ko Taar kɛn Raa ɛɗo Musa ki se aanga ɓaara tak ɓo jeege lee tɛɗ *sɛrkŋ kaam kalaŋ ese se sum ɓo *Raa ki, naɓo jee kɛn lee ɓaaɗo naan Raa ki gɛn tɛɗn sɛrkgen ese se, sɛrkɗege se, ɔŋ aasɗe gɛn ɗaapɗe kaakŋ bɛɛ naan Raa ki eyo.

Bin ey num jeegen lee tɛɗo sɛrkgen ese se, kaaɗn naane *kusin̰ɗege se Raa tugɗesin̰ga naatn gɛn sɔrɔkin̰a. Ɔɔ naaɗe kɔŋ jeel roɗe ki naaɗe se jee kusin̰ge eyo, mɔɔtn naaɗe tɛɗn sɛrkɛ Raa ki taa kusin̰ɗege ey sum.
Num gaŋ sɛrkgen kɛn aanga ɓaara tak ɓo, naaɗe lee tɛɗ se, ute naan̰ se, naaɗe jeel roɗe ki kusin̰ɗege se utu gɔtin̰ ki.
Taa moosn kɔs‑taarge ute gɛn baalge se, ɔŋ aas te gɛn kɔɔɗn kusin̰ jeege eyo.
Taa naan̰ se ɓo kaaɗ kɛn *al‑Masi iin̰o gɛn ɓaaɗo do naaŋ ki se, naan̰ taaɗ Raa ki ɔɔ:

content.text: Moosn maalge ute nakgen kꞋlee kꞋjꞋɛɗi se tap ɓo,
naai je eyo, num naai ɛɗumo roa.
Maalgen kꞋtɔɔlɗe jaay kꞋtɔɔcɗe ute moosn kɛn kꞋtɔjo sɛrkɛ taa kusin̰ se tap ɓo, tɔɔli naai ki eyo.
Anum maam mꞋtaaɗo mꞋɔɔ: Aan gɔɔ kꞋraaŋo do dɔkin̰ maakŋ Kitap ki taa maam se,
maam mꞋara se, mꞋɓaaɗoga, Raa, taa mꞋai tɛɗ nakŋ maaki jea.

content: Deet deet se al‑Masi taaɗ ɔɔ: «Naai Ꞌje te sɛrkŋ maalge eyo, gɛn nakgen jꞋɛɗi se eyo, ɔɔ naai je te jaay tɔɔl maal jꞋaisin̰ tɔɔc eyo ɔɔ ute sɛrkgen kꞋtɛɗi taa tɔɔl kusin̰ jeege se eyo kici, nakgen se naai tap ɓo Ꞌje eyo, taa naaɗe se paac tɔɔli naai ki eyo.» Ey num kꞋjeelki, sɛrkgen ese se Ko Taar kɛn Raa ɛɗo Musa ki taaɗga taaɗ ɔɔ jeege an̰ lee tɛɗa.
Tɛr naan̰ taaɗ ɔɔ: «Maam mꞋara mꞋɓaaɗo se gɛn tɛɗn nakŋ kɛn naai maaki jea.» Bin ɓo ɗoobm kɛn jeege lee eem Raa do dɔkin̰ se ɔn̰in̰ga cɛɛs ki ɔɔ naan̰ ɓaanoga ute ɗoobm kuuy gɔɔn̰ ki.
Isa al‑Masi se tɛɗga nakŋ kɛn Raa maakin̰ jen ro ki; naan̰ mala ɛɗ ron̰ sɛrkɛ Raa ki jɛ‑kalaŋ sum gɛn sɔrɔkin̰a. Ute sɛrkŋ naan̰ se ɓo, naajege kꞋtɛɗkiga jee *salal naan Raa ki.

KꞋjeelki, *debm tɛɗn sɛrkɛ Raa ki se, naŋa naŋa kic ɓo, ɓii‑raa naan̰ ɗaar ute jɛn̰a gɛn tɛɗn naabin̰a. Daayum se, naan̰ lee tɛɗ sɛrkgen ese sum, naɓo sɛrkgen se, ɔŋ aas te gɛn kɔɔɗn kusin̰ jeege eyo.
Gaŋ al‑Masi se, naan̰ tɛɗ sɛrkɛ mɛt kalaŋ lak taa kusin̰ jeege se ɔɔ sɛrkŋ naan̰ se ɔs aay gɛn daayum ɔɔ ɓɔrse naan̰ utu iŋg do ji daam Raa ki.
Ɔɔ naan ki se, naan̰ utu iŋg booy bini jee wɔɔyin̰ge se, Raa aɗen tɛɗn naan̰ ɓo utu kiŋg doɗe ki.
Bin ɓo ute sɛrkŋ naan̰ tɛɗ jɛ‑kalaŋ se gɛn tugŋ kusin̰ jeege se, jee naan̰ge se naan̰ tɛɗɗen tɛɗga jee salal naan Raa ki gɛn sɔrɔkin̰a.
Naan̰ se Nirl Salal kic ɓo ajeki tɛɗn saaɗa taa taargen jaay naan̰ taaɗ ɔɔ:

content.text: Mɛljege Raa ɗeek ɔɔ: Ɓiigen aɗe ɓaa naan ki se, maam mꞋutu mꞋdɔɔkŋ ute naaɗe.
Maam mꞋaɗe kɛɗn jeele gɛn jeel ɗoobumge
ɔɔ ɗoobumge se mꞋaɗesin̰ taaɗn kɔmb maakɗe ki.

content: Tɛr naan̰ taaɗ ɔɔ:

content.text: Kusin̰ɗege ute tujɗege se, mɔɔtn maam mꞋsaapm do ki ey sum.

content: Anum, kɛn jeege jaay kusin̰ɗe kꞋtɔɔlɗesin̰ga naatn se, mɔɔtn naaɗe Ꞌtɛɗn sɛrkɛ taa kusin̰ɗege ey sum.
KꞋɓaakiro naan Raa ki
Bin ɓo, gɛnaamge, moosn Isa se tɛɗjekiga jꞋaaskiga gɛn kɛnd maakŋ gɔt kɛn *salal cir paac paac se ute maraadjege.
Isa ɓo debm ɔɔɗjeki ɗoobm kiji ɔɔ gɛn kaaja ute ɗoobm kal deer kɛn nɛɛp se ɔɔ kal deer nɛɛpm se lɛ, taaɗ te ron̰ kɛn ooy ro kaag ki se.
Ɔɔ naajege jꞋɔkki *debm tɛɗn sɛrkɛ Raa ki magala kɛn jꞋɔndin̰ naan̰ ɓo naan *Ɓee Raa.

Bin num kꞋɓaakiro naan Raa ki ute maakŋ kalaŋ, jꞋaalki maakjege paac don̰ ki, taa *kusin̰ maakjege tu se lɛ Isa tug ɔɔɗin̰ga naatn maakŋ‑saapjege tu ɔɔ rojege kic ɓo naan̰ *tug ɗaapin̰ga ute maan jiga.
Taar kɛn naajege kꞋtaaɗki naan jeege tu jꞋɔɔki jꞋɔndki dojege do ki se, jꞋɔn̰ten naajki, taa Raa se naan̰ tuj ɔrmin̰ eyo, nakŋ naan̰ taaɗga ɔɔ an̰ tɛɗ se lɛ, naan̰ utu an̰ tɛɗn ɗeere.
KꞋsaapki do naapge tu kɛn ajeki kɔl jꞋaki je naapa ɔɔ jꞋaki lee tɛɗn nakgen jiga.
JꞋɔn̰te kɔn̰ki gɛn tus ute naapa aan gɔɔ jee mɛtin̰gen lee tɛɗ se, naɓo jꞋɛɗki kaay kaama naapge tu, taa Ꞌtap se kꞋjeelki, ɓii kɛn Mɛljege aɗe ɓaa se, ɔɔpga gɔɔrɔ.
Anum naajegen kꞋjeelkiga jeel mala mala nakŋ kɛn mɛt ki se jaay kɛn naajege malin̰ge sum ɓo jꞋiŋgki kꞋtɛɗki kusin̰ se, ɓɛrɛ, taa kusin̰ se, *sɛrkŋ kuuy gɔtɔ.
Num ɔɔp ɓo nakŋ ɔɔn̰ kɛn utu booyjeki se bɔɔr kɛn utu koocn̰ dojege tu ɔɔ ute pooɗn ɔŋgɔ kɛn utu kɔsn jeegen baate tookŋ taar Raa se.
ꞋJeelki, debm jaay tujga do *Ko Taar kɛn Raa ɛɗo Musa ki se, ɔɔ kɛn jeege dio ey lɛ mɔtɔ tɛɗga saaɗge se, debm bin se jꞋan̰ kɛɛjn̰ don̰ ki eyo, jꞋan̰ tɔɔlɔ

ꞋSaapki tu Goon Raa se debm jaay aalin̰ maak ki eyo, ɔɔ moosin̰ kɛn *dɔɔkjeki ute Raa jaay tɛɗjeki jee salal se kic, naan̰ aakin̰ aan gɔɔ nakŋ cɛrɛ ɔɔ naaj *Nirl Raa kɛn tɛɗjeki bɛɛ se, debm bin se, mɛt kando Raa an̰ dabar makɔn̰ cir daal ey la?

Ɗeere, naajege se kꞋjeelki debm kɛn taaɗ ɔɔ: Maam mala mꞋutu mꞋkɔgŋ sɛɛm ute ɗoobin̰a ɔɔ naŋa naŋa kic ɓo, maam mꞋan̰ kɔgŋ bɛɗin̰ do kusin̰in̰ kɛn naan̰ tɛɗa. Ɔɔ tɛr naan̰ taaɗ ɔɔ: Mɛljege Raa se utu kɔjn̰ bɔɔrɔ do jeen̰ge tu.
Ɓɛrɛ, debm jaay oocga ji Raa kɛn zɛɛrɛ se, utu an̰ tɛɗn ɔɔn̰ aak eyo.
ꞋSaapki tu, do kiŋgse kɛn deet deete kɛn naase aakkiro gɔtn wɔɔr kɛn iin̰o gɔtn Raa ki ɔɔ kaaɗ kɛn naane se, ɗeere, naase Ꞌdabarkiroga dɛn aak eyo ɔɔ ɗokiroga ɗo jɛt.
Gɔtn mɛtin̰ge jee maakse ki se kꞋnaajɗenoga ɔɔ kꞋdabarɗenoga naan jeege tu anum naasen jee kuuy se jee kɛn kꞋlee kꞋdabarɗeno se, naase ɔn̰ɗeki te kalɗe ki eyo.

Bin ɓo gɛnaasegen dabar maakŋ daŋgay ki se, dubarɗe se ɔɔn̰se naase kici. Ɔɔ kɛn jeege jaay ɓaaɗo tɔsnga ute naksege se, naase ɔn̰ɗesin̰ki ute maak‑raapo, taa naase Ꞌjeelki maal kɛn naase utu aki kɔŋ se naan̰ jiga cir paac paac ɔɔ tiŋg gɛn daayum.
Nakŋ kɛn naase Ꞌjeel ɔkkiga mɛtin̰ maakse ki se ɔkin̰ki tɔɔgɔ ɔɔ ute naan̰ se, naase aki kɔŋ nakŋ bɛɛ dɛn aak eyo.
Bɛɛki se, naase Ꞌjeki kaay kaama taa kɛn naase jaay Ꞌtɛɗ aaskiga nakŋ kɛn Raa maakin̰ jen ro ki se, Raa se naan̰ utu asen kɛɗn nakŋ kɛn naan̰ taaɗsenga taaɗ ɔɔ utu asen kɛɗ se.
Taa Kitap taaɗ ɔɔ:

content.text: Kaaɗin̰ ɔɔpga baata, ɔɔpga cɔkɔ sum ɓo
ɔɔ debm kɛn utu aɗe ɓaa se, naan̰ utu aɗe naar ɓaa,
ɔɔ ɓɛrɛ, naan̰ Ꞌkɔŋ booy ey sum.
Ɔɔ debum kɛn tɛɗ nakge ute ɗoobin̰ se
utu Ꞌkɔŋ kaaja taa naan̰ aalga maakin̰ dom ki.
Num gaŋ kɛn naan̰ jaay ɔk tɛrlga ɗoob ki num,
debm tɛɗ bin se tɔɔlum maam ki eyo.

content: Num gaŋ naajege se kꞋmɛtn jee ɔk tɛrlga ɗoob ki se eyo gɛn ɓaa gɔtn kut ki se, num naajege se kꞋmɛtn jee kɛn aal maakɗe do Raa ki gɛn kaajn̰ koɗe.
